title: Benchmark Suite Core — 15 Parts + Formula Proofs
description: Build comprehensive benchmark suite: 8,640 S/F tests + 1,728 deflection tests + 1,200 Ra tests. Verify physics formulas against published literature and establish regression baselines.

units.title: BenchmarkSuiteEngine: Core infrastructure audit
steps: Verify test harness for parametric sweeps

units.title: Kienzle Formula Proof: kc = kc1.1 × h^(-mc)
steps: Verify Kienzle coefficients against ISO 3685 and Kronenberg (1966)
Create test cases for all 6 ISO material groups (P, M, K, N, S, H)
exit_conditions: 36+ test cases pass (6 groups × 6 h values)

units.title: Taylor Tool Life Proof: VT^n = C
steps: Test n exponent by tool material (HSS=0.1, carbide=0.25, ceramic=0.5)
Validate C constants against tool manufacturer data
Test extended Taylor with temperature factor
exit_conditions: Tool life predictions within ±15% of published data

units.title: Deflection Formula Proof: δ = FL³/3EI
steps: Test I calculation for cylindrical tools: I = πd⁴/64
Test boring bar deflection with L/D > 4 warning
exit_conditions: 48+ test cases pass (8 tool diameters × 6 overhangs)

units.title: Surface Finish Formula Proof: Ra = f²/(32R)
Chatter Stability Proof: a_lim = -1/(2Ks×Re[G(ω)])
steps: Validate optimal RPM in stability pockets

units.title: 15-Part Benchmark Suite: Representative geometries
steps: Define 15 benchmark parts spanning all operations
Include: facing, OD turning, ID boring, threading, milling, drilling
Create expected results for each part

units.title: Parametric Sweep Infrastructure: 8,640 S/F combinations
steps: Configure: 6 ISO groups × 8 ops × 12 tools × 5 machines × 3 DOC = 8,640
